title: JWT encoder: create and sign a JSON Web Token online
description: Build a JWT from a JSON payload and sign it with a secret using HS256, HS384 or HS512. The token is created in your browser and the secret is never sent anywhere.

ui.secretNote: The token is signed in your browser and the secret is never sent anywhere.
ui.noSecret: Enter a secret: the token can’t be signed without one.
ui.shortKey: This secret is too short for {alg}: {bytes} of {min} bytes. The standard (RFC 7518) requires a key at least as long as the hash, and some libraries will reject the token.

errors.json: The payload isn’t valid JSON: check quotes, commas and brackets
errors.object: The payload must be a JSON object in curly braces
